Signature line reads 'Randy Horiuchi / hmastakes' (signed by an agent), dated 2/14/13. Summary Page header block filled: Page 1 of 1, Horiuchi, 2/14/13. Figures are written without thousands commas ('7560.00', '6660.26'). Line 3 chains from the 2008 year-end amendment's line 7 (21.32). Arithmetic checks: 21.32 + 7,560.00 = 7,581.32 and 7,581.32 - 6,660.26 = 921.06.

contributions.detail: delta 1,500.00, FULLY EXPLAINED BY THE DOCUMENT ITSELF. The 42 transcribed rows sum to 9,060.00, which is exactly the printed spreadsheet total - and that printed 9,060.00 is STRUCK THROUGH, with a handwritten bracket around the last five amounts (250 + 250 + 500 + 250 + 250 = 1,500.00) annotated '(1,500.00) Reflected in 2010 disclosure' and a handwritten corrected total of $7,560. 9,060.00 - 1,500.00 = 7,560.00 = the stated total. Nothing adjusted; the five affected rows are flagged individually.

expenditures.detail: exact for the LIVE rows: the five un-struck rows sum to 6,660.26 = the handwritten corrected total = stated. The printed total 7,760.26 is struck through and the two struck 2010-dated rows (600.00 + 500.00 = 1,100.00) are annotated 'included in 2010 disclosure'; 6,660.26 + 1,100.00 = 7,760.26, so the document's own arithmetic closes on both figures.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: This is a spreadsheet attachment with no per-page SUBTOTAL rows - only one total per schedule. Schedule A: 29 rows on p3 (5,735.00) + 13 rows on p4 (3,325.00) = 9,060.00 = the struck printed total - GATE PASSES against the pre-amendment figure. Schedule B: 5 live rows = 6,660.26 = the corrected total, and all 7 rows = 7,760.26 = the struck printed total - BOTH identities close.

itemized.notes: AMENDED FINAL report; p1 cover, p2 Summary Page, pp3-5 a LANDSCAPE typed spreadsheet attachment (Schedule A across p3-p4, Schedule B on p5) that must be rotated to read. TWO FILER AMENDMENT ANNOTATIONS, both fully reconciled above: 1,500.00 of contributions and 1,100.00 of expenditures were struck/bracketed as 'reflected/included in 2010 disclosure'. SCHEDULE A HAS NO DATE COLUMN - the spreadsheet's columns are Last/First/[address]/City/State/Zip/Occupation and Employer/Contributed, so no contribution date exists anywhere in this document; every contribution date is blank by non-existence, never inferred from the report date. The street-address column is covered by a solid black redaction box on both pages, but City and State survive and are transcribed (ZIP discarded per the privacy rule). GEOMETRY IS OMITTED on all rows: these are rotated landscape pages and I could not convert row bands back to portrait page percentages with confidence. Row-to-row alignment between the left (name) and right (city/occupation/amount) blocks was screened and is 1:1 in order, confirmed by three independent semantic matches (Karrenberg/'Lawyer, Anderson & Karrenberg'; Iwamoto/'Councilwoman/Salt Lake County'; Wilson/'Councilwoman/Salt Lake County') and by equal row counts on each page.
